McpServerDefinition.description: Governed Apex over the CLM portfolio: list contracts, resolve one and its Box documents, ask Box AI, draft a counter-position memo, prepare a signature request. Box credentials stay in Apex, so a client never holds a Box token.

tools.descriptionOverride: Finds documents across every governed contract carrying a given clause risk (Critical, High, Medium, Low), with a link to each. Bounded to the contracts root by configuration - a caller never supplies a folder id.

Lists CLM contracts with reference, counterparty, status, risk and value, optionally filtered by status or counterparty. Use this to answer a portfolio question, then take each reference to the contract package.

Finds a CLM contract from the reference a person used, its governed Box folder, and a link to every document. Call before asking about a document or previewing one: the file ID is the last path segment of each link.

Asks Box AI about one document of a named contract, by a Box file ID from that contract's package. A file outside that contract is refused. With itemType hub it reads the approved clause library instead.
tools.toolTitle: Ask Box AI About a Contract Document

tools.descriptionOverride: Generates the counter-position memo for a contract into its own Box folder, from the clause at issue, the approved fallback and the precedent the caller cites. Contract facts come from the record. The memo is a draft and approves nothing.

Sends one contract document for signature with Box Sign. The signer defaults to the configured demo address. Always call it rather than judging eligibility yourself - the refusal names the blocking contract status.
tools.toolTitle: Send for Signature with Box Sign
